name: Auto-Tune
author: Vocal Monitor
description: Pro-grade vocal pitch correction. YIN pitch detector + TD-PSOLA shifter + 16th-order LPC formant preservation with bandwidth expansion + Lanczos-3 windowed-sinc interpolation + 20 ms input lookahead + GCI grain snapping + vibrato preservation + adaptive retune + transient bypass. Pick a preset from the list (Natural / Pop / Hard / Cher / Country / Subtle) or dial Retune / Humanize / Strength / Formant by hand. Key, Scale and Mix are always user-controlled.

presets.name: Natural
presets.description: Gentle pop correction that preserves the performance

presets.name: Pop
presets.description: Modern pop vocal — snappy but still musical

presets.name: Cher
presets.description: The original 'Believe' chipmunk character (no formant preservation)
